llm_explanation.summary: The leaf shows signs of Cedar-apple rust infection.
llm_explanation.prediction_explanation: The classifier predicts Cedar-apple rust (Apple Cedar Apple Rust) with high confidence.
llm_explanation.visual_evidence: Grad-CAM identifies image regions that influenced the classifier prediction; it is not ground-truth disease localization.
llm_explanation.knowledge_evidence: Retrieved agricultural knowledge provides general information about the predicted and related classes; it does not establish image-specific symptoms.
llm_explanation.uncertainty_note: The prediction margin is very large, but the model's trust score is very high.
llm_explanation.human_review_recommendation: Human review can be used to independently verify the classifier prediction when appropriate.
